name: fix_policy
prompt:
Fix these defects found in code review. Output full corrected tea/trip.py, tea/policy/rules.py, tea/policy/classify.py.
1) TIMEZONE: card timestamps are Asia/Seoul. Meal days and location must use the destination LOCAL date. Add optional `tz` to each destination (IANA name). If absent, default from country via a COUNTRY_TZ map (FR Europe/Paris, GB Europe/London, US America/New_York but US cities SF/Palo Alto -> America/Los_Angeles, CA America/Toronto, SG Asia/Singapore, AE Asia/Dubai, MA Africa/Casablanca, CH Europe/Zurich, PL Europe/Warsaw, NL Europe/Amsterdam, BE Europe/Brussels, DE Europe/Berlin, ES Europe/Madrid, IT Europe/Rome, KR Asia/Seoul, JP Asia/Tokyo). Add Trip.local_dt(dt)->datetime converting to the tz of the destination active at dt (fallback: tz of first destination). eligible_meal_day must take the local date; departure_at/return_arrival_at compared in their own tz as given.
2) _nights_per_city builds NAIVE datetimes and compares with aware -> TypeError. Fix: use destination from/to directly: nights per destination = (to.date()-frm.date()).days in local tz, min 1. Key by normalized city.
3) City matching must be case/accent-insensitive (normalize: casefold, strip accents via unicodedata, map 'brussels'->'bruxelles', 'montreal'->'montreal', 'new york city'/'nyc'->'new york', 'sf'->'san francisco').
4) classify_heuristic: use word-boundary regex matching, not substring (current bugs: 'Dinner' matched 'inn'->hotel, 'Fairmont' matched 'air'->flight, 'Metal' matched 'eta'->visa, 'Grab' is a ride-hailing app -> taxi, not meal). Order: specific brands first. Add: 'air france','korean air','asiana','lufthansa','british airways','united','delta','emirates','klm','easyjet','ryanair' -> flight; 'hotel','hôtel','novotel','ibis','accor','marriott','hilton','hyatt','airbnb','booking.com','expedia hotel','agoda','hotels.com','ihg' -> hotel; 'uber','bolt','g7','taxi','lyft','grab','free now','kakao t' -> taxi; 'ratp','tfl','navigo','metro','subway' -> taxi? NO -> 'public_transport' (new category, PASS); 'restaurant','resto','cafe','café','coffee','bistro','brasserie','boulangerie','bakery','starbucks','paul','pret','mcdonald','burger','pizza','sushi','deliveroo','uber eats','식당','카페' -> meal ('uber eats' must win over 'uber'); 'esta','vfs','k-eta','visa fee','etias','eta uk' -> visa; 'insurance','assurance','보험' -> insurance; 'hertz','avis','sixt','europcar','enterprise rent' -> car_rental; 'sncf','eurostar','trainline','ouigo','db bahn','ktx','korail','amtrak' -> train. Do not include 'apple' or 'eta' alone.
5) classify prompt: country is not interpolated (missing f). Ask models to answer JSON only. Return tuple-free: classify(txn, llm=None)->str unchanged signature. Add classify_with_meta(txn, llm=None)->dict(category, source='heuristic'|'llm'|'llm-disagree', models=dict).
6) Add category 'public_transport' -> PASS. 'car_rental' in US: cap $75/day (FLAG if per-day exceeds; days = rental nights, unknown -> 1 -> FLAG 'verify rental length'); elsewhere FLAG 'local law'. 'mileage' -> FLAG 'attach map screenshot'. 'equipment' -> FLAG 'not a travel expense; remote budget'. 'other' -> FLAG 'unclassified'.
7) Remove dead code (`if False else`, trailing no-op loop). Pre-trip bookings: rules.evaluate accepts txns outside trip window; if approved_at < trip.start and category in (flight, train, hotel, visa) add reason 'pre-trip booking' (status unchanged). If outside trip and other category -> FLAG 'outside trip dates'.
8) Location for meal/hotel: prefer trip.location_for(txn.approved_at); if txn is before trip start use first destination; after end use last destination.

name: fix_io
prompt:
You are taking over these modules from another model; fix all defects. Output full corrected tea/sheets.py, tea/ledger.py, tea/deel_web.py, tea/evidence/ocr.py, selectors/deel.json, plus NEW tea/google_auth.py and tea/drive.py.
sheets.py defects: (a) _batch_update writes all updated rows starting at A2 regardless of their real row -> must map txn_id -> row number from column A and use POST values:batchUpdate with one ValueRange per row (range '<sheet>!A{n}:T{n}'), valueInputOption RAW. (b) no retry: implement _request(method,url,**kw) retrying 429/500/502/503/504 up to 3 retries with exponential backoff using self.sleep; raise httpx.HTTPStatusError after. (c) ranges: HEADER has 20 columns -> A:T not U. (d) ensure_header must overwrite row 1 when it differs from HEADER. (e) quote sheet names with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1" and URL-encode the range. (f) append uses POST {range}:append?valueInputOption=RAW&insertDataOption=INSERT_ROWS. (g) chunk updates/appends at 500 rows. (h) Dedupe input rows by txn_id (last wins). Keep row_for signature but accept city/country None -> ''. Add submit_status/deel_ref update helper: set_status(txn_id, submit_status, deel_ref='').
ledger.py: Ledger(path: str|Path) creating parent dirs; statuses: new (implicit when absent), drafted, submitted, skipped. Allowed: new->drafted, new->submitted, drafted->drafted (re-draft allowed, idempotent), drafted->submitted, new->skipped, drafted->skipped. submitted is terminal (ValueError on any change). skipped->drafted allowed only via reopen(txn_id). Store updated_at and ref. Add all()->list[dict]. Use context manager support.
deel_web.py: (a) select_option misuse: support two dropdown kinds from selectors: if selectors['category_select_kind']=='native' use page.select_option(sel, label=value) else click the combobox then click option via template formatted with {value}. Same for currency. (b) Deel EOR may not have drafts: 'draft' means: fill the form fully, take a full-page screenshot of the filled form to out_dir/{txn_id}.deel_form.png, and DO NOT click submit; leave form open (caller decides). Ledger -> drafted. (c) approve=True: fill (if needed) and click submit, wait for confirmation_ref or form_error (raise DeelFormError with error text), ledger -> submitted with ref. Works from new or drafted. (d) never touch the page when ledger==submitted -> 'skipped-duplicate'; policy FAIL -> 'skipped-fail' and ledger skipped. (e) check session_expired AFTER goto and before each step -> AuthRequired. (f) map our categories to Deel category labels through selectors['category_map'] (dict) with fallback selectors['category_default']. (g) amount: format with 2 decimals, currency ISO. (h) Accept DeelWeb(selectors_path, ledger, out_dir='~/.tea/deel'). Remove unused sync_playwright import. selectors/deel.json: include all keys incl. category_map {hotel:'Accommodation',meal:'Meals',flight:'Travel',train:'Travel',taxi:'Transportation',public_transport:'Transportation',car_rental:'Transportation',visa:'Travel',mileage:'Mileage',gift:'Other',other:'Other'}, category_select_kind 'combobox', currency_select_kind 'combobox', expenses_url 'https://app.deel.com/expenses' (placeholder, user calibrates).
ocr.py defects: float vs Decimal TypeError in amount compare; use Decimal; normalise amounts like '1,234,000원', '€ 45,50' (comma decimal when exactly 2 digits after comma and no dot), '$1,234.5', 'KRW 12,000'; match txn.amount OR txn.amount_krw. Merchant tokens: regex \w+ tokens casefolded, ignore tokens < 2 chars; Korean merchant names: also accept if the full merchant string (spaces removed) is a substring of OCR text with spaces removed. OCR client: retry 429/5xx 2 times; timeout 60s; model param default 'mistral-ocr-latest'.
google_auth.py: token_provider(credentials_path, scopes=('https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file')) supporting service account json (google.oauth2.service_account) and authorized-user json (google.oauth2.credentials.Credentials.from_authorized_user_file); refresh with google.auth.transport.requests.Request when expired; returns Callable[[],str].
drive.py: DriveUploader(http, token_provider, folder_id=None, sleep=time.sleep).upload_png(path, name)->str webViewLink using multipart upload https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id,webViewLink; if a file with same name exists in folder (search q=name='..' and trashed=false and '<folder>' in parents) return existing link (idempotent). Retry like sheets.
